result.summary: 本文介绍了 DeepSeek-V3，一个总参数 671B、每 token 激活 37B 的 MoE 语言模型，采用 MLA 与 DeepSeekMoE 架构，并引入无辅助损失的负载均衡策略和多 token 预测训练目标 [abstract][S1.p2]。模型在 14.8T token 上预训练，随后进行 SFT 与 RL 后训练，并蒸馏 DeepSeek-R1 的推理能力 [S1.p4]。综合评测显示其性能超过其他开源模型，并可与领先闭源模型相比 [abstract][S1.p5]。完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时，且训练过程稳定，未出现不可恢复的 loss spike 或回滚 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在进一步推动开源模型能力边界，通过扩大模型规模并引入 DeepSeek-V3 来缩小与闭源模型的差距 [S1.p1]。同时，作者希望兼顾强模型性能与经济成本，因此在架构上继续采用 MLA 和 DeepSeekMoE，并额外探索负载均衡与多 token 预测策略 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: To further push the boundaries of open-source model capabilities, we scale up our models and introduce DeepSeek-V3
With a forward-looking perspective, we consistently strive for strong model performance and economical costs.
DeepSeek-V3 still adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for efficient inference and DeepSeekMoE for cost-effective training.

method.text: DeepSeek-V3 采用 MLA 进行高效推理、DeepSeekMoE 进行经济训练，并引入无辅助损失的负载均衡策略以减轻负载均衡带来的性能损失 [S1.p2][S2.SS1.p1]。模型还设置多 token 预测训练目标，在训练中预测额外 token，并观察到其提升评测基准上的整体表现 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。训练方面支持 FP8 混合精度，并设计 DualPipe 流水线并行算法以重叠计算与通信 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing
DeepSeek-V3 employs a multi-token prediction training objective, which we have observed to enhance the overall performance on evaluation benchmarks.
we additionally introduce an auxiliary-loss-free load balancing strategy for DeepSeekMoE to mitigate the performance degradation induced by the effort to ensure load balance.
we investigate and set a Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) objective for DeepSeek-V3, which extends the prediction scope to multiple future tokens at each position.
we introduce an FP8 mixed precision training framework and, for the first time, validate its effectiveness on an extremely large-scale model.
we design the DualPipe algorithm for efficient pipeline parallelism, which has fewer pipeline bubbles and hides most of the communication during training through computation-communication overlap.

experiments.text: DeepSeek-V3 在 14.8T 高质量多语言 token 上预训练，最大序列长度 4K，随后通过两阶段 YaRN 将上下文扩展到 32K 和 128K [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1][S4.SS3.p1]。后训练包括 1.5M 指令微调实例的 SFT 和采用 GRPO 的 RL [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS2.p1]。评测覆盖多学科选择题、语言理解、问答、阅读理解、数学、代码等基准，并与 DeepSeek-V2-Base、Qwen2.5 72B Base、LLaMA-3.1 405B Base 等开源模型比较 [S4.SS4.SSS1.p2][S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: the training corpus for DeepSeek-V3 consists of 14.8T high-quality and diverse tokens in our tokenizer.
We set the maximum sequence length to 4K during pre-training, and pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T tokens.
we apply YaRN for context extension and perform two additional training phases, each comprising 1000 steps, to progressively expand the context window from 4K to 32K and then to 128K.
We curate our instruction-tuning datasets to include 1.5M instances spanning multiple domains
Similar to DeepSeek-V2, we adopt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
we compare the base model of DeepSeek-V3 with the state-of-the-art open-source base models, including DeepSeek-V2-Base (our previous release), Qwen2.5 72B Base, and LLaMA-3.1 405B Base.

findings.text: 综合评测显示 DeepSeek-V3 超过其他开源模型，并达到与领先闭源模型可比的性能 [abstract][S1.p5]。其基础模型在多数基准上表现最佳，尤其在数学和代码任务上 [S4.T3]。聊天版本在标准与开放式基准上超过其他开源模型，并与 GPT-4o 和 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 可比 [S1.p5]。训练成本方面，完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时，且训练过程稳定，未出现不可恢复的 loss spike 或回滚 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models.
DeepSeek-V3-Base has emerged as the strongest open-source base model currently available, especially in code and math.
DeepSeek-V3-Base achieves the best performance on most benchmarks, especially on math and code tasks.
Its chat version also outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models, including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet
Despite its excellent performance, DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training.
Throughout the entire training process, we did not experience any irrecoverable loss spikes or perform any rollbacks.

limitations.text: 作者承认 DeepSeek-V3 在部署方面存在局限：为保证高效推理，推荐部署单元相对较大，可能给小团队带来负担 [S6.p2]。此外，尽管其端到端生成速度已超过 DeepSeek-V2 两倍以上，仍有进一步提升空间 [S6.p2]。作者表示这些局限有望随更先进硬件的发展自然解决 [S6.p2]。

evidence.quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.
there still remains potential for further enhancement.
these limitations are expected to be naturally addressed with the development of more advanced hardware.
